$comment: Snapshot of the MCP connectors installed on the claude.ai account of Pol4720.
This file is DECLARATIVE — it records what should exist, so the workspace can be
rebuilt on a new account or shared with a colleague. Connectors cannot be installed
from a file: each one is added at claude.ai > Settings > Connectors, and the ones
with "auth": "oauth" additionally require an interactive login that only the
account owner can perform. See docs/03-manual-setup-checklist.md.

connectors.name: bioRxiv
connectors.purpose: bioRxiv and medRxiv preprint search and metadata
connectors.used_for: Preprint discovery for vaccine and epidemiology work

connectors.name: Clinical Trials
connectors.used_for: Trial design, endpoint comparison, investigator search

connectors.name: ICD-10 Codes
connectors.used_for: Diagnosis and procedure coding in clinical datasets

connectors.name: Open Targets
connectors.purpose: Drug target discovery and prioritisation platform

connectors.name: PopHIVE
connectors.purpose: Yale harmonised US public-health surveillance data

connectors.name: PubMed
connectors.purpose: Biomedical literature search and full text
connectors.used_for: Literature review; the citation backbone of the paper auditors

connectors.name: Canva
connectors.purpose: Search, create, autofill and export Canva designs

connectors.name: Cloudflare Developer Platform
connectors.used_for: Deployment and edge storage for web projects

connectors.name: Consensus
connectors.purpose: Scientific literature search with claim-level evidence
connectors.used_for: Evidence synthesis; complements PubMed and Elicit

connectors.name: Demographic and Health Surveys
connectors.used_for: Population health indicators by country and survey

connectors.name: Elicit
connectors.purpose: Paper search, systematic review and extraction

connectors.name: Hugging Face
connectors.used_for: Model and dataset discovery for ML projects

connectors.name: Microsoft 365
connectors.note: Present in the account but not authenticated and not enabled in chat. Connect it only if institutional documents are needed.

connectors.name: Monte Carlo
connectors.note: Present in the account but not authenticated. Requires a Monte Carlo tenant.
